title: CAM-Guided Saliency Cutout and Image-Based Malware Classification
abstract: arXiv:2608.11634v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Dropout regularization is commonly used to reduce overfitting by removing parts of a neural network during training. For Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), cutouts serve a somewhat analogous purpose. Cutouts can be implemented as data augmentation: the original training image is retained, and additional copies are created with regions removed. In this chapter, we test whether cutout placement can be improved by using High-Resolution Class Activation Mapping (HiResCAM). We compare four controlled training conditions: no cutout, standard random cutout, low-saliency cutout, and high-saliency cutout. translated_title: CAM引导的显著区域裁剪与基于图像的恶意软件分类
translated_abstract: 丢弃正则化通常通过在训练期间移除神经网络的部分来减少过拟合。对于卷积神经网络（CNN），裁剪（cutout）起到类似的作用。裁剪可以作为数据增强实现：保留原始训练图像，并创建带有区域移除的额外副本。在本章中，我们测试了是否可以通过使用高分辨率类激活映射（HiResCAM）来改进裁剪位置的选择。我们比较了四种受控的训练条件：无裁剪、标准随机裁剪、低显著区域裁剪和高显著区域裁剪。我们使用来自RawMal-TF数据集的灰度恶意软件图像（17个家族，每个家族约1000个样本）进行实验，并与自然图像对比，使用了著名的CIFAR-100数据集。所有实验基于ResNet18，训练约100个epoch。对于裁剪实验，我们测试了约5%、10%、20%的裁剪面积。
tldr: 本文提出利用高分辨率类激活映射（HiResCAM）指导裁剪位置，通过对比随机、低显著和高显著裁剪在恶意软件图像分类中的效果，验证了基于显著性的裁剪能提升模型性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes using HiResCAM to guide cutout placement, comparing random, low-saliency, and high-saliency cutouts in malware image classification, demonstrating that saliency-based cutouts improve model performance.
